Runs Apify Actors (ready-made scrapers and automations) and reads their datasets and stores.

## API key

1. Open [console.apify.com](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** The API token from Apify Console, Settings > API & Integrations.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add apify
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  apify: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Apify's [API](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show apify` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 60 calls a second. 60 requests per second per resource (one Actor, run, dataset or store); 250,000 requests per minute per user overall.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Apify).
